race.comment: MYSTERY MAIL (4) finished fourth last start, beaten 12 metres at this track over 2090m. Perfectly placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. BACK YA TRUCK UP (5) faces the starter for the first time. By Captain Crunch and hails from the P A Ashwood stable. Showed some ability when a minor placegetter in a recent trial. Well-placed to score at his first appearance. VINJETTA (8) has to come into calculations on the back of some strong recent form, most recently when fourth at this track over 1609m. Must be included in combinations. VINCENT THE THIRD (1) showed pleasing improvement last time out when runner-up over 1609m at this track. In the mix.
